name: Scheduler
description:
An events calendar for planning: maintenance windows, bookings and shifts. Month, week, day
and agenda views share a header with previous, next, Today, the visible range and a view
switch. Overlapping events sit side by side; all-day and multi-day events run as bars in a
band above the hours, and a month cell that overflows offers "+N more". The grid is drawn in
the browser's zone or `timeZone`. Click or drag over empty time to select a slot; with
`editable`, drag events to move them, drag their lower edge to resize, or focus one and use
the arrow keys (Shift for the end). In a narrow container the week shows one day with a day
strip and the month shows dots with the selected day's events below. It fills its
container's height; give it one (a Panel body, a sized region).
signature: <E extends SchedulerEvent = SchedulerEvent, R extends SchedulerResource = SchedulerResource>({ events, view: viewProp, defaultView, onViewChange, layout, views, continuous, hiddenDays, onRangeChange, date: dateProp, defaultDate, onDateChange, timeZone: zoneProp, locale: localeProp, weekStartsOn, now: nowProp, loading, editable, resizable, eventEffect, snapMinutes, slotMinutes, scrollToTime, onEventClick, onSlotSelect, onEventChange, resources, renderEvent, renderResource, resourceHeader, resourceWidth, columnWidth, dropAccept, validateDrop, blocks, onDrop, actions, compact: compactProp, labels, className, style, "aria-label": ariaLabel, }: SchedulerProps<E, R>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: actions
props.description: Content beside the view switch: an Add button, filters.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the whole scheduler. Default the visible range.

props.name: blocks
props.description: Timeline: when resources are not available (leave, closures), shaded on their rows.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout only.

props.name: columnWidth
props.description: Timeline: the narrowest a day column gets before the timeline scrolls sideways (a CSS length). Default by view.

props.name: compact
props.description: Force the compact form (one day column, dots in the month) on or off. Default: by the container's width.

props.name: continuous
date
props.description: A day in the range shown (controlled): the month, week or day around it.

props.name: defaultDate
props.description: The first day shown when uncontrolled. Default today in `timeZone`.

props.name: defaultView
props.description: The first view when uncontrolled. Default "week".

props.name: dropAccept
props.description: Timeline: which of your DragDrop items its rows take (a type, types or a test). Default none: rows only take its own events.

props.name: editable
props.description:
Let people move and resize events by dragging and with the keyboard. A function decides per
event; returning a string locks the event and says why ("Sent to the crew").

props.name: eventEffect
props.description: Timeline: whether dragging an event moves it (default) or copies it, leaving it in place (templates, repeating work).

props.name: events
props.description: The events to show. Keep the array stable between renders; a new array drops optimistic changes the host has not kept.

props.name: hiddenDays
props.description: ISO weekdays to leave out (1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday): `[6, 7]` hides weekends. Applies to the week view and the timeline.

props.name: labels
props.type: Partial<{ views: string; month: string; week: string; day: string; agenda: string; today: string; previous: (view: SchedulerView) => string; next: (view: SchedulerView) => string; allDay: string; more: (count: number) => string; moreLabel: (count: number, day: string) => string; dayLabel: (day: string, count: number) => string; timeRange: (start: string, end: string) => string; eventLabel: ({ title, when, resource }: { title: string; when: string; resource?: string; }) => string; editHint: string; slots: (day: string) => string; slotsHint: string; slotFocused: (when: string) => string; moved: (title: string, when: string) => string; resized: (title: string, when: string) => string; changeFailed: (title: string) => string; noEvents: string; noEventsIn: (range: string) => string; agendaLabel: (range: string) => string; loading: string; now: (time: string) => string; weekDays: string; continues: string; resources: string; noResources: string; timelineSlots: (range: string) => string; timelineSlotsHint: string; timelineEditHint: string; copied: (title: string, when: string) => string; refused: (title: string, reason: string | null) => string; atResource: (resource: string, when: string) => string; }> | undefined
props.description: Replace any of the wording (see `schedulerMessages`).

props.name: layout
props.description:
How day, week and month are drawn. "calendar" (default): hours in day columns and a month
grid. "timeline": a row per resource and a column per day, events as bars in their
resource's row (`resourceId`). The agenda is the same in both.

props.name: loading
props.description: Events are loading: the grid keeps its geometry and shows placeholders where events go.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for names, times and the first day of the week. Default the nearest `LocaleProvider`, then `configureLocale()`, then `<html lang>`.

props.name: now
props.description: The current time, for today and the time line. Default the clock, updated each minute.

props.name: onDateChange
props.description: Called with the new day when the person moves with previous, next, Today or a day's heading.

props.name: onDrop
onEventChange
props.description:
Called when the person moves or resizes an event. The event shows at its new time at
once; update `events` to keep it there. Return a promise to hold it there until it
settles: a rejection puts it back and announces that the change failed.

props.name: onEventClick
props.type: ((event: E, details: { element: HTMLElement; }) => void) | undefined
props.description: Called when the person opens an event (click, tap or Enter).

props.name: onRangeChange
props.description: Called with the days shown whenever they change, to load their events.

props.name: onSlotSelect
props.description:
Called with an empty stretch of time chosen by click, drag or keyboard; in the timeline with
its row's `resourceId`. `details.element` is the highlighted selection, to anchor a popover
to. Without it, empty time cannot be selected.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Called with the view the person switches to, or "day" when they open a day's heading.

props.name: renderEvent
props.description: Timeline: the content of an event's card, instead of its title and time. Buttons and links in it keep their own behaviour.

props.name: renderResource
props.description: Timeline: a row's heading, instead of its title and description.

props.name: resizable
props.description: Whether an editable event's ends can be changed. Default: when it is editable. A function decides per event (single-day tasks that only move).

props.name: resourceHeader
props.description: Timeline: the heading above the row headings ("Staff", a search field). Default "Resources".

props.name: resources
props.description: Resources named on events by `resourceId`, and the timeline's rows in this order (sticky ones first).

props.name: resourceWidth
props.description: Timeline: the width of the row headings column (a CSS length). Default 14rem.

props.name: scrollToTime
props.description: The time of day the week and day views scroll to when they open ("07:00"). Default "07:00".

props.name: slotMinutes
props.description: Minutes in one slot of the time grid: its lines and what a click selects. Default 30.

props.name: snapMinutes
props.description: Minutes that drags and arrow keys snap to. Default 15.

props.name: style
props.description: Layout only.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: The IANA zone whose wall clock the grid shows ("Australia/Sydney"). Default the browser's.

props.name: validateDrop
props.type: ((drag: DragInfo, resource: R, target: SchedulerDropTarget) => DropVerdict) | undefined
props.description:
Timeline: whether a row takes the item being dragged now, or why not, for its own events and
your items alike. `target` is where it would land: the day, the proposed interval and the
resource's blocks it would overlap. Asked again as the day or row under it changes, and for
moves and resizes made with the keyboard.

props.name: view
props.description: The view shown (controlled).

props.name: views
props.description: The views in the switch, in order. Default month, week, day and agenda; with the timeline layout day, week and month.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: First day of the week, 1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday. Default the locale's.
